evidence: Published queue elapsed_seconds; metrics and protocol checked against captured Git blobs. Raw receipt replay and peak telemetry remain pending.
compatible_work_unit: one asset: native generation, same-anchor stationary control, both official scoring arms, source/input/weight checks and complete receipt
pair_timer_limitation: Excludes work before worker started timer and after pair.json was written; do not use it for whole-unit admission.

scheduling_recommendation.estimate_rule: ceil(1.35 * max(compatible historical and current whole-unit elapsed_seconds)); allow below the legacy 2400s floor.
scheduling_recommendation.admission_rule: Start one complete scientific comparison only when remaining authorized execution time >= its family estimate + 1800s reserve.
scheduling_recommendation.reserve_activation: Only predeclared, data-ready, scientifically qualified work; activate by capacity/readiness, never by observed favorable effects.
invalidate_for: changed frame count, steps, precision or model
changed evaluator, sampling or output verification
scheduling_recommendation.new_family_calibration: Measure 2-3 complete comparisons with all planned arms; include these in the frozen denominator and total budget. Do not transfer this one-arm-generation-plus-static prior blindly.

future_execution_authorization.total_execution_limit: record in the next run manifest; historical continuation authorization binds the old 16-asset inventory only
